ruleset.name: Complexity Report Ruleset
ruleset.description: Report-only variant of pmd-complexity-ruleset.xml, used exclusively by scripts/complexity-report.sh (the trending hotspots snapshot — see code-reviewer skill §18.2's "trending" note). methodReportLevel is set to 1 so PMD reports EVERY method's complexity as a "violation", letting the script rank them and take the top N, rather than only the ones over the real max-15 gate's threshold. Never used by `mvn pmd:check` (the actual gate) — that continues to use pmd-complexity-ruleset.xml's methodReportLevel=16 unchanged.
